verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own documented self-hosting lets users run the rendezvous/relay server themselves via an official compose file, so they decide where connection infrastructure and data sit (rustdesk-docs-1, -2, gh-1). Pro adds distributed relay servers, and community users confirm running their own servers (comm-6, comm-13). One user's unease about default relays possibly being in Beijing concerns the vendor-hosted default, not the self-hosting option, so it lowers confidence rather than the verdict. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency or region documentation, region selection for the vendor-hosted servers, and clarity on where default relay servers are located.
